# Manic Medic

> CPD templates for paramedics in New Zealand, Australia, the UK and the USA, written by Colin Bamforth, a paramedic with nearly 40 years on the road.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://manicmedic.com/): the CPD portfolio pack, a free reflection template, and an overview of CPD requirements for each country.

## Books

- Shift-Worker Stress Workbook: for shift workers in emergency services, construction, mining, offshore and transport. Link to the book page to be added on publication.
